lessons.rule: Keep taking event straddles that state an explicit expected-move threshold; skip ones that don't.
lessons.evidence: 2/2 wins (CSCO Aug 11 + Aug 12); straddles without stated thresholds were ungradable.

lessons.rule: Stand down when the open gaps beyond the entry/stop/target geometry. Do not chase re-anchored entries.
lessons.evidence: Multiple NQ setups invalidated by gap-opens. Gold stop-out: planned 4430, filled 4468, stopped 4400.

lessons.rule: On macro-miss days, enforce PP-hold confirmation before sizing intraday index longs.
lessons.evidence: W33 Friday: both index longs closed red (-0.88R combined) on double-miss day. Day advisory said 'below PP = sidelines'.
